CHAPTER III
The Chamber of Colours
Colour is the strongest magic in LEGO — and one wizarding set out-coloured almost everything ever made.
Diagon Alley Wizarding Shops (2025) is the #2 most colourful LEGO set ever made — of any theme, ever. 2,750 parts across 55 real brick colours, a riot of magic after the yellow years.

distinct colours in a single set
